d: 🌟 We're Hiring: Marketing Officer (Digital & Social Media)

We are a growth-oriented organization focused on digital marketing, brand development, and strategic communication across international markets. Our marketing activities combine creative content, digital channels, and audience insights to strengthen brand visibility and build meaningful relationships with customers. We value fresh ideas, effective communication, and data-informed marketing strategies that support sustainable business growth.

We are looking for a proactive Marketing Officer (Digital & Social Media) to support our digital marketing activities and strengthen our online presence. In this part-time remote position, you will contribute to social media planning, content development, campaign coordination, and audience engagement. You will work closely with internal teams to deliver consistent brand messaging, improve digital performance, and identify opportunities to expand our reach across relevant platforms.
Coordinate digital marketing activities in line with business objectives and brand guidelines.
Develop and manage social media content calendars across relevant platforms.
Create engaging marketing content, captions, and promotional materials.
Support the planning and execution of digital marketing campaigns.
Monitor social media engagement, audience growth, and campaign performance.
Research market trends, competitor activities, and audience preferences.
Maintain consistent brand messaging across digital communication channels.
Coordinate with creative, sales, and business development teams on marketing initiatives.
Respond to audience interactions and support online community engagement.
Prepare marketing reports and recommend improvements based on performance insights.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field preferred.
Minimum of 3+ years of relevant professional experience preferred.
Strong understanding of digital marketing and social media management.
Knowledge of content planning, brand communication, and online audience engagement.
Familiarity with major social media platforms and digital marketing trends.
Proficiency in preparing written content and coordinating promotional campaigns.
Ability to interpret engagement metrics and evaluate campaign performance.
Strong communication, creativity, and organizational skills.
Ability to manage multiple marketing activities and meet deadlines.
Comfortable working independently and collaborating with remote teams.
Flexible part-time working hours with a fully remote arrangement.
Competitive compensation based on experience and responsibilities.
Opportunities to contribute to international digital marketing campaigns.
Creative involvement in brand development and social media initiatives.
Professional growth through exposure to evolving digital marketing strategies.
A collaborative environment that encourages creativity, fresh ideas, and innovation.

r: As part of the sales team the primary role of this position is to maximize our on-shelf presence in all outlets
served by the merchandiser. Additionally, when required the merchandiser will conduct in-store sampling
sessions and in-store sampling and/or promotions. Planograms must be adhered to for both on and off shelf
displays. Any non-compliance to the agreed arrangements must be reported to the pre-seller immediately. In
addition to these duties the merchandiser is required to supply the pre-seller with the latest market
information in order to take advantage of any selling opportunities.
 Call on specific OT outlets as per daily journey plan provided by your supervisor.
 Merchandize SSFL products within your OT stores in the various access points, shelf, stand, floor display.
 Place POS material wherever applicable next to our SSFL displays.
 Ensure all access points are merchandized as per approved planograms.
 Rotate product using FIFO method, and remove sub-standard products.
 Maintain clean and fresh stock of SSF products on the shelf at all times.
 Report any deviations from agreed terms with your assigned OT customer / outlet.
 Report daily activities of the prior day to your supervisor.
 Participate in sampling / redemption campaigns when required.
 Maintain appropriate personal appearance, and professional behavior in line with Frito Lay code of conduct.
